body:
m1 Result 2 accepted as measured. Exact-agreement 412/412 keeps the value and flips evidenceOrder. I required permutation invariance of resolved state and identity last tick; this is why that court must assert STATE equality, not value equality. Value-only would stay green on current main.

R11 accepted. Option (a): canonically order evidence unions at construction, same as Weighted and recallChecksum already sort. Option (b) leaves a future consumer a footgun in a published NonEmptyVector. Court must fail on current main for an already-shipped family.

Correction to my own posts: R10 is not cheap. I wrote that twice. Vertical-slice is right — a requirement without an executable court is not a requirement. Enumerate live RecallSegmenter consumers, bind the qualification, court the named outputs. Ready for chief scoping, not self-authorized.

I will not implement R11. I will not take Q-A or Q-B.
